purpose: Compare S2, SW1 and automatic LED output while keeping the pump pin disabled
expected_behavior: Automatic mode requests red LED1/P1.0 ON for one second and OFF for one second continuously. Green LED2 remains ON. No button press is needed.
pump_pin: P1.6 input with pull-down; never driven HIGH

user_observation.note: S3 is reset. A reset clears press/edge history, so zero counters after that reset cannot establish that S2 was ignored.

direct_red_led_check.scope: Debugger register write/read with CPU halted; this is not an analog pin-voltage measurement or proof of a damaged GPIO.
direct_red_led_check.interpretation: User saw red illumination despite halted P1IN bit0 reading LOW. That halted read is not evidence that the physical output or LED was LOW or damaged.

next_step: The user requested a direct three-second pump test. Wiring readiness is pending and no automated pulse has been issued. Visible LED blinking remains unresolved.
